metadata.description: Reusable Agent Skills for quantitative finance research, extracted from the Aria toolchain.

plugins.name: quant-research-skills
plugins.description: Skills that enforce research discipline for equity reports, factors, and strategy backtesting through evidence and deterministic validation gates.

plugins.name: app-engineering-skills
plugins.description: Skills that help the user build and enforce their own app-engineering conventions — a design system of their choosing, reference-product UI patterns (X, TradingView, Trading212) for trading/investing apps, the category disciplines (dense terminals vs. conversational UI), the generation-time craft pass that keeps AI-built UI from reading as templated, plus editorial/poster styling, rights-aware music direction, and short-form video delivery for ARIA exports and standalone creative assets across any domain — separate from the quant-research pipeline.

plugins.name: realty-operations-skills
plugins.description: Skills for operating-rights and revenue-share property arrangements, where the counterparty reports the number that determines what they owe. Separate vertical from the public-market research pipeline — verifying a private operator's declared revenue is a different discipline from analysing a listed company.

plugins.name: enterprise-operations-skills
plugins.description: Skills for operating a company's own internal systems through an agent — IT incident response, vendor-contract audit, and warehouse/logistics ERP checks. Separate vertical from the public-market research pipeline: these read and act on internal systems of record, so every one of them ends at a human approval gate rather than at a conclusion.
